set.body: Full TemplateFlow catalog dogfooding found two .mat transforms rejected by BidsName.parseGeneric. Compound .surf.gii/.shape.gii/.label.gii/.func.gii names are accepted only as extension gii, incorrectly folding the media type into the suffix. Add known scientific extensions longest-first, retain generic versus registry validation boundary, and verify exact suffix/extension roundtrip on JVM and JS.
